Both sources confirm the use of a splitting process driven by residual distortion to generate the initial codebook, which is then refined by the normal LBG algorithm (implying the splitting process replaces the standard random initialization phase of LBG). The evidence confirms the splitting is deterministic (based on distortion/variance), greedy (picking max distortion), and driven by residual distortion.
